name: Finish The Word! [ SUMMER ]
desc:
Poodle -> Elephant -> Turtle! Keep the chain alive in this fast-paced word game!

Each round, say a word that starts with the last letter of the word before it. The longer the game goes, the harder it gets.

💬 One word at a time
🔁 No repeating words
⚡ Think fast or get knocked out
🐶 Use pets to gain special abilities
🧠 May the sharpest brain win

👍 Like the game and join the group for future updates!
